The '''Core Worlds Security Zone''' was a portion of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]], which existed in [[137 ABY]]. The zone consisted of most of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEA" />
